objectives.statement: Identify the three main parts of a short Norwegian message or email.
Choose a greeting that fits a friendly or polite message.
Choose and use a suitable sign-off in a short message or email.
Build a complete short message with natural Norwegian order and conventions.

notes: Must teach the structure and conventions of short messages and emails in Norwegian: a greeting, a brief body, and a sign-off, with register-appropriate phrases. Defer deeper professional/conversational tone choices and the rare marked De/Dem/Deres system to formal_vs_informal_register.
